content: Lucas quillcan Teofiloma
Ñáuca llaquishca Teófilo, Ashca runaguna Jesus ñucanchihuacpi rashcagunamanda yachachishcagunamandahuas quillcanaushcami.
Jesushuan ñaupapunda purisha yachachiucunata uyasha quillcanaushcami.

Chasna acpi ñucahuas quillcasha nini. Jesusta ricuc runagunahuan ñuca alita tapusha pundamanda yachangahua nisha munashcani. Yachasha pai callarishcamanda tucurinagama canda cunan quillcauni llaquishca Teófilo.
Canda ñaupa yachachishcaguna sirtu ashcata can yachachun quillcauni.
Angel riman Juanba yayahuan

Ñáaupa uras Herodes nishca amu Judea llactata mandashca uraspi shuc israel pagri Zacarias causac ara. Paiga tucui pagri muntunmanda Abías nishca muntun mara. Paihua huarmihuas Isabel nishca chasnallata huañuc apayaya Aaronmanda mirai huarmi ara.
Paiguna ishcandi Diospacpi ali sumac causaccuna ashcauna. Ishcandi tucui Dios mandashcagunata uyasha, Dios munashcata pactachisha causaccuna ashcauna.
Randi huarmi mana huahuayagashcamanda huahua illac causac anaura. Paiguna ishcandi ña yapa rucuyashcauna.
Shuc punzha Zacariaspa muntunguna Diosta alabana huasibi tarabanata raushcaibi Zacariasrandita tucucpi Diospa huasi ucuma yaicura ali asnac pulbuta Diospacpi rupachingahua.
Chi pulbuta rupachiushcai ashca israel runaguna canzhaibi ausha Diosta alabasha mañanaura.
Chasna acpi Zacariaspa ñaupacpi Diospa angel ricurira, chi pulbuta rupachina jahua cajun mayanbi shayarisha, paihua ali maqui partima.
Zacarias angelta ricusha ashcata manzharira.

Chi angel randi paita cuintara, Zacarias nisha, ama manzharinguichu. Dios can paita tapuushcata uyasha rangami, camba huarmi Isabel shuc cari huahuata huahuayangami nira. Huahuayacpi Juan nishcata shutichingui nira.
Chi huahuata huahuayacpi cushiyanguimi, chasnallata camba churimanda ashca runagunahuas cushiyangaunami nira.
Diospacpi yapa balic runa tucungami. Paiga vinotas ima machachina yacutahuas mana upingachu. Astahuanbas pai pagarishca urasmanda Diospa Samai yuyaita cushcami anga.
Pai chasna asha israel runagunata yachachicpi ashcaguna jatun Diosta cuti catingaunami.

Dios cachamungaraushca runa shamunagama camba churi runagunata yachachiungami. Camba churi ñaupa causac Eliascuinta Diospa yuyaihuan ushaihuanbas puringami. Chasna purisha yachachisha yayagunahuan churigunahuan alichingami, mana uyac runaguna uyac tucungahua pai camachingami. Chasna camachisha tucui runagunata yachachingami Dios cachamungaraushca runata catinauchun nisha.
Angel chasna rimacpi Zacarias tapura, Can sirtupacha rimashcata imasata yachasha. Ñáuca yapa rucu mani, ñuca huarmihuas huahuata mana tupaibac, paihuas yapa rucu man nira.
Chasna nicpi angel rimara, Ñáuca Gabriel mani, Diospacpi shayac mani nira. Pai ñucata cachahuarami cai cushi shimitaga canda rimangahua.
Ñáuca rimashca shimiga sirtu pactaringami. Cunanga ñuca rimashca shimita can mana quirishcamanda shuc shimitas mana rimac tucungui, ñuca rimashcashina camba churi pacarinagama mudu tucungui nira.
Angel Zacariashuan rimaushcai tucui canzhaibi auc runaguna pai imamanda Diosta alabana huasi ucuibi unaita tiyaushcata mana yachanaurachu.
Zacarias ña llucshisha rimanata mana usharachu. Mudu mana rimac tucusha maquillahuan ricuchira. Chasna racpi runaguna asirtanaura pai Diosta alabana huasi ucuibi tiyausha muscuibicuinta ricushcata.
Diosta alabana huasibi tarabashcahuasha Zacarias paihua quiquin huasima rira.
Mana unayasha paihua huarmi huicsayara. Chasna huicsayasha paihua huarmi pichca (5) quillagama huasimanda mana canzhama llucshira.
Chasna huicsayashami Dios cunan ñucahuacpi yapa alita rashcami nisha rimara, ñuca llaquirishcata pai pasachishcami huahuata mana tupac ashcamanda runaguna ama mas asihuanauchun nisha.
Diospa angel riman virjin Mariata
Sucta (6) quillahuasha Dios paihua angel Gabrielta provincia Galileama cachara Nazaret nishca llactama.
Paita cachara shuc Maria nishca malta huarmihuagma. Chi huarmiga ñaupa causac israelgunata mandac rey amu Davidmanda mirai mara, Jose nishca runa tapushca mara.
Angel shamusha Mariata rimara, Cambagma shamuni canda rimangahua. Diosca cambacpi tiyaun. Tucui huarmigunamanda balichishca tucunguimi can.
Chasna rimacpi Maria yapa manzharisha, Imangahuata chasna rimahuan nisha yuyarira.
Pai chasna yuyariucpi angel nira, Ama manzharichu Maria. Diospacpi balichishca mangui.
Huahuata huahuayanguimi, carihuahuata. Paita Jesus nishcata shutichingui.
Pai yapa ali mandac amu tucungami. Jahuapachai Diospa Churi nishcami anga. Camba churi paihua huañuc apayaya rey amu Davidcuintallata mandac tucunga jatun Dios munashcaraicumi.
Chasna rasha tucui israel runagunata huiñai mandagmi tucunga. Pai mandanaga ima uraspas mana tucuringachu.
Chita uyasha Maria angelta rimashca, Cari illac mani. Imasata ñucaga huahuayasha cari illacca.

Angel randi paita rimashca, Diospa Samai cambagmami shamunga. Jatun Diospa ushaihuanmi puyucuinta cataitucungui. Chimanda can huahuayangaraushca churiga jucha illac manga, Diospa Churi man nishca tucunga.
Chasnallata canda nini camba aillu Isabel ña apa aushcai huahuayasha shuc churita charingami. Mana huahuayagashallata cunanga sucta (6) quilla tuputa charishca.
Dios tucuitaga ushac man nisha angel rimashca.
Tucuita uyashcahuasha Maria rimashca, Jatun Diosta cadsuc mani, chasna tucuchun can rimashcacuinta. Chasna rimashcahuasha paihuagmanda angel llucshisha rira.
Virjin Maria Isabelbagma rira
Angel cuintashcahuasha mana unayasha Maria Judea provinciama shuc llactai rira urcu partita.
Chima pactasha Zacariaspa huasima yaicusha Isabelta saludara.
Saludashcata Isabel uyacpi paihua huicsa ucuibi auc huahua cushparira. Isabel Diospa Samaihuan yaicushca asha cushihuan rimashca,
Tucui huarmigunamanda Dios canda mas yali balichishca mangui nira. Camba huahuas Diospacpi balichishcami saquiringa.
Mana balicchani ñuca jatun amuhua mama ñucama shamungahua.
Ñáucata can saludacpimi ñuca huicsa ucui tiyauc huahuaga cushihuan cushparihuara.
Dios canda rimashca shimi pactaringaraushcata can quirishcamandami cushi mangui nisha Isabel rimashca.
Mariaga Diosta alabasha cantan
Isabel rimashcahuasha Mariaga casna nisha Diosta alabara,

content.text: Ñáuca shungu ucui jatun Diosta yapa balichiuni.
Pai quishpichic ashcamanda ñuca tucui shunguhuan cushiyani.
Ñáuca Diosta cadsuc, pugri agllaita ñucata yuyarihuashcami.
Cunanmanda tucui runaguna ñucamanda Dios paita balichishcami nishami cuintangaraunguna.
Tucuita rac Dios jatun rashcataga ñucahuacpi rashcami.
Paiga jucha illac sumac man.
Pundamanda huiñaigama tucui paita manzhac runagunata yuyarisha yanapashami cuiran.
Pai rashcagunamanda ushaita ricuchishcami.
Balic mani nisha alabariccunata anchuchishcami.
Mandac runagunataga paiguna mandanamanda Dios llucshichishcami,
randi mana balichishca runagunataga mandac tucushun nisha churashcami.
Raicasha tiyaucunama ashca aligunata cushcami.
Chariccunata randi imas illacta callpachishcami.
Paihuacta rasha causac israelgunata Dios yanapashcami.
Ñáucanchi callari apayaya Abrahandas paimanda miraigunatas Dios rimashcami tucui uras cangunata yuyarisha yanapashami nisha.
Pai rimashcata mana cungarisha israelgunata yuyarisha yanapaunmi.

content: Chasna nisha Maria Diosta alabara.
Pai ñalla quimsa (3) quillata Isabelhuan pasiara. Chihuasha paihua quiquin huasima bulltiara.
Juan pagarishcamanda
Chihuasha Isabel ña cari huahuata huahuayashca.
Paihua ailluguna, mayanbi causaccunahuas Dios paita rimashcashina cari huahuata huahuayashcata uyasha paigunahuas cushiyashcauna.
Chasna acpi huahua pusac (8) punzha charishcai Moises mandashcacuinta pitina uraspi chi ailluguna paihua yaya Zacarias nishca shutillatata shutichinguichi nisha rimashcauna.
Randi paihua mama rimara, Mana chasna shutichan, paihua shutiga Juan man.
Nicpi rimashcauna, Randi camba aillugunahuacpi chi shutiga mana tiyanzhu.
Chasna paiguna rimanacusha maquita cuyuchisha Zacariasta tapushcauna paihua churihua shutita.
Tapucpi Zacarias chasnallata maquita cuyuchisha quillcata tapusha quillcara, Paihua shutiga Juanmi. Quillcacpi tucui ailluguna ricusha imasna rashata chi shutitaga shutichira nisha manzharinaura.
Zacariasca chi urasllata paihua shimihuan rimanata ushashca, ushashami Diosta alabangahua callarishca.
Chasna tucucpi tucui runaguna manzharinaushca. Chasnallata tucui Judea provincia urcu llactagunaibi tiyac runagunas tucuibi chimanda cuintanacushcauna.
Tucui paigunata uyaccuna yuyarishcauna imasata chi huahuaga tucunga nisha. Diosca paihua ushaita chi huahuama sirtu cungaraushca mara.
Zacarias Diosta alabara
Chi huahuahua yaya Zacariasca Diospa Samai jundacta yaicushca asha Dios yuyachishca shimigunata rimashca casna nisha,

content.text: Israelba jatun Diosta alabashca achun paihua runagunata yuyarisha pai quishpichingahua shamushcamanda.
Diosta sirbic rey amu Davidmanda miraitami shuc yapa ushaita charic quishpichictaga cachamushca.
Ñáaupa urasmanda Dios rimashcata pasachic paihuacpi ali causac runagunata yuyachisha nira, Ñáucanchita piñaccunamandahuas tucui ñucanchita mana llaquiccunamandahuas Dios ñucanchita quishpichishcami.
Ñáucanchi huañuc apayayagunata yuyarisha yanapashami Dios paigunata mana paquibac rimashca ali shimita mana cungarishcachu.
Ñáucanchi huañuc apayaya Abrahanma Dios ñaupa rimashcata chara yuyarisha cunan pactachishcami.
Chasna yuyarisha ñucanchita piñaucunamanda quishpichinmi ñucanchi paihuacta mana manzhaihuan rangahua.
Chasnallata tucui ñucanchi causanagama jucha illac sumac causasha paihuacta rana manchi.
Chasnallata canga jatun Dios rimashcata pasachic runa tucungui churi.
Quishpichic runa shamunagama paihua runagunata Diospa quishpina shimita yachachingui ñucanchi juchagunata pai anchuchingami nishca shimita yachachisha.
Ñáucanchi Dios yapa llaquisha yanapashcamandami jahuapachamanda ñucanchima pai cachamushca runaga ñucanchita punzhayachishcacuinta quishpichingami.
Chi ansaibicuinta juchata rasha puriu runagunata huañuimanda llushpichisha quishpichingami.
Dios cachamungaraushca runaga ñucanchita paihua ñambita ricuchingami Dioshuan cushi causanauchun nisha.

content: Chasna nisha Zacarias Diosta alabashca.
Paihua churi Juan nishca, huiñasha ali yuyaiyuc tucura. Chaquishca pambaibi causaura israel runagunata camachina urascama.
